about_the_game:
"Purification Office"is an innovative game inspired by Chinese and Japanese urban legends and ghost culture, integrating match-three mechanics, roguelike card gameplay, and ghost storytelling adventures.

Match-Three + Roguelike Cards

Purification Office merges classic Zuma match-three elements with roguelike card gameplay, creating a unique creative experience.Players must analyze their cards to devise optimal strategies and place them in the correct spiritual positions to ensure all spirits are eliminated.While eliminating spirits one by one may work in regular exorcism activities, as ghosts surge in, failing to exploit the 'gaps' between spirits for a continuous elimination will surely turn you into 'food' for them.

Harnessing Ghosts

In the game, each spirit has a unique background story and fitting appearance. As the exorcism progresses, surprises are always in store for you.Upon defeating spirits, players can capture them and gradually increase their affinity through offerings, unlocking new plotlines and unique skills.However, frequently borrowing the powers of ghosts to fight may cause you to lose something important...

Office Recruitment Announcement

The Office is temporarily recruiting four types of temporary workers, all related to ghostly professions.The agency will provide professional training to ensure you can become a Taoist priest, monk, ghost master, shaman dancer, etc., inheriting the skills of great exorcists skilled at dealing with all kinds of spirits since ancient times.The agency has developed many different branches for these professions, for example, Taoists skillfully using talismans, and ghost masters being able to control spirits.

Atmosphere and Story

Purification Office aims to provide players with an intense supernatural experience close to that of a real-life escape room atmosphere.The game incorporates numerous details that align with players' imaginations of the supernatural, attempting to vividly depict the eerie world of urban legends. The game immerses you in the chilling atmosphere of classic films, hoping you can recall the whispers and sighs of ghosts at midnight in the alley.

More Fun Gameplay

As you acclimate to this world, you will discover they aren’t as terrifying as you imagined, and making friends with ghosts can actually be a delightful experience.They look forward to your nurturing actions, but be sure to manage the depth and extent of your involvement to avoid becoming too deeply entangled.

content_descriptors.notes:
Aboutmature content in the game:
It only features relatively sexy female outfits and sexual suggestiveness, without depictions of sexual acts or extreme violence. It also does not contain potentially sensitive topics for players.

short_description: Welcome to Purification Office. Purification Office is an innovative game that blends match-3, Zuma, and paranormal adventures. By chance, you join a company that aims to eliminate ghosts. As stories are revealed, there seem to be deeper secrets hidden behind this supernatural world.
